title: Map current rules-pack claim, authority, and defect state for the ADR 0020 transition
description:
Produce docs/audits/rules-awareness-transition/2026-07-29-current-state-claim-and-defect-map.md: an evidence-based map of what Eshyra currently claims about the rules pack, engine readiness, and defects under ADR 0020.

Inventory and trace present authority and consumers for source-fidelity/provenance claims, source/reference completeness, semantic readiness, pack-wide/negative executability, deterministic capability, state-kernel invariants, model-adjudication classifications, GAMEPLAY_READINESS_DISPOSITIONS, RULE_DISPOSITIONS, ENGINE_PROCEDURE_COVERAGE, srdPlayabilityAudit.ts, srdChoiceProseAudit.ts, srdEquipmentResolutionAudit.ts, itemExecutionReadiness.ts, the ADR 0019 inventory/census, engine:F1-F10, the freeze manifest and thaw-note gate, open SRD findings, and real runtime consumers of the generated pack.

Keep the five ADR 0020 dimensions independent: source fidelity, discovery, adjudication, deterministic capability, state integrity. Preserve every known defect; do not close, retire, or reclassify findings. Distinguish verified fact, inference, and open question.

Sibling of eshyra-jued (discovery-substrate map) in the same directory; not a duplicate. Documentation only: no generated pack output and no production code changes.
notes:
PR #484 first review (CHANGES REQUESTED at 63895c6): two report defects, both correct, both fixed at 226b4d0.

1. FALSE [VERIFIED] CLAIM CORRECTED: I wrote that RulesAmbiguity 'has no runtime consumer' and 'never reaches the DM'. Wrong. lookupRulesTool returns record: result.record UNCHANGED (toolLookupRules.ts:169-170) and the ambiguities live at record.data.mechanics.ambiguities, so the material DOES reach the DM on lookup of the three records. My grep was field-specific and missed the generic whole-record consumer. Narrower true defect: reaching the DM is conditional on the model independently choosing the exact containing record; no automatic surfacing, no campaign-ruling store/resolver, no ruling-to-capability path.

LASTING LESSON for anyone tracing pack-data consumers: 'no field-specific reader' NEVER means 'unreachable'. lookup_rules returns the whole record, so every field of any pack record is DM-reachable on request. The distinction is now documented in report §4.12. The audit registries (GAMEPLAY_READINESS_DISPOSITIONS, RULE_DISPOSITIONS, ENGINE_PROCEDURE_COVERAGE, the srd*Audit modules, the ADR 0019 inventory) genuinely have no consumer in either sense -- they are code/docs, not pack records.

2. D-5 RECAST (not removed): it stated 'Violated invariant: none -- design property' while being counted as a live defect and said to block approval. Now recast around the concrete still-active claim: the zero-engine-pending re-freeze bar, still recorded VERBATIM in eshyra-olc5 notes and still blocking eshyra-o9bd.14 and eshyra-2zyy, infers completeness from an open schema. Invariant: ADR 0020 §3. The open-schema properties moved to new §7A 'Architectural constraints -- properties, not defects', not counted among §6.1's nine. §6.1 gained a status key separating: live-with-instances (D-1..D-4, D-6..D-8) / live-claim-no-instance (D-5) / structurally-present-no-trigger (D-9). D-7, D-8, D-9 gained explicit violated-invariant lines.

3. NEW VERIFIED FACT found while writing §7A (a drafted claim that per-kind validators close the mechanics object was probed and proved FALSE): key closure over data.mechanics exists for magic-item ONLY. Injecting data.mechanics.madeUpKey is REJECTED for magic-item:adamantine-armor (magicItemMechanics.ts:468) but ACCEPTED for spell:fireball and creature:goblin. data.mechanics.saves[0].madeUpKey is ACCEPTED. data.madeUpKey is ACCEPTED even on magic-item. requireOnlyKeys (kindSchemas.ts:923) closes ~20 nested sub-objects, not the mechanics object above them. So the only corner of the corpus where a schema-closure argument is available at all is magic-item.data.mechanics -- the same kind that carries executionReadiness and feeds the live runtime gate. Relevant to eshyra-olc5.3/.4 (certify clause-complete absence) and to F1.

Verified at 226b4d0: verify:worktree 262 files / 4709 tests passed, 19 documented skips. Reply posted: PR #484 comment 5126826648. Awaiting re-review.
